changeSet.author: snapdragon
changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO games (id, name, description, slug, sort_order, created_at) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1 FROM games), 'Connect Four', 'Drop discs to connect four in a row horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. Two players; the host runs the engine, the server streams moves.', 'connect-four', (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM games), NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM games WHERE slug = 'connect-four');
INSERT INTO chapters (name, description, slug, scene_type, sort_order, asset_url, scene_config, game_id, created_at) SELECT 'Connect Four', 'A 7x6 grid. Drop a disc into a column; first to four in a row wins.', 'connect-four', 'connect-four', 1, '/api/assets/levels/connect-four/index.html', '{}', (SELECT id FROM games WHERE slug = 'connect-four'), NOW() WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chapters WHERE slug = 'connect-four');
